name: easy-codex-limit-check
description: Show Codex Pro 5h and weekly rate-limit remaining percentages in the macOS menu bar using your local Codex login.

interface.shortDescription: Live Codex Pro 5h and weekly limit monitor for your Mac menu bar.
interface.longDescription: A local Codex plugin and companion macOS menu-bar app that read Codex/ChatGPT usage from the signed-in Codex session, write normalized rate-limit state to a local file, and display 5h plus weekly remaining percentages with reset times.
